scope: Screen wet layers on every six-hour state and at the final restart of a closed freshwater summer trial.
freezing_implementation: GSW 3.6.23 in-situ freezing temperature of freshwater, with dissolved-air saturation fractions 0 and 1, evaluated against local sea pressure in dbar.
persistent_condition: The same wet node and layer is more than 0.01 degrees Celsius below the air-saturated local freezing point on consecutive six-hour records.
cold_adjudication: Exclude a trial with a substantial or persistent cold excursion from restart selection. Report its location, duration, affected volume and local heat balance.
hot_adjudication: Report warm source-range exceedances, locations, wet volume and duration together with surface and river heat. Gross upper-bound violations invalidate the native trial.
